datadog.description: Datadog hosted MCP (Preview). Auth via DD_API_KEY + DD_APP_KEY (App key needs scope `mcp_read`; add `mcp_write` only if you actually need to mute/silence monitors). Override DD_MCP_URL for non-US1 sites: datadoghq.eu, us3.datadoghq.com, us5.datadoghq.com, ap1.datadoghq.com, ap2.datadoghq.com. NOT GovCloud-eligible. See SETUP.md.

statsig.description: Statsig hosted MCP. Header auth via STATSIG_CONSOLE_API_KEY (https://console.statsig.com/api_keys → type=Console → scope=omni_read_only). For browser-based OAuth, omit headers. Use omni_write only for skills that toggle gates / start experiments. See SETUP.md.
